reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, product_name, SUM(units) AS units, SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN units ELSE 0 END) AS store_units
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
GROUP BY product_id, product_name
ORDER BY units DESC, product_id
LIMIT 10

solver.query:
SELECT product_id, product_name,
       SUM(units) AS units,
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN units END), 0) AS store_units
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31'
GROUP BY product_id, product_name
ORDER BY units DESC, product_id ASC
LIMIT 10
